launches.tagline: Meet Agentive, the AI Workspace for Auditing and Client Collaboration.
launches.body:
**TL;DR** Agentive completely redesigned document requests to eliminate confusion and unnecessary busy work—reducing client rework by 25% and streamlining audits. Uploaded documents become AI-drafted workpapers aligned with your firm’s templates, cutting review time by 90%.\
<https://youtu.be/7V5hTATJm3E>

# **Improving the client-auditor relationship, one request at a time**

The toughest part of an audit isn’t issuing the opinion—it’s getting the right documents on time. Existing solutions still confuse clients, require significant training, and lead to re-work that strains relationships. Agentive set out to change this by making document requests seamless and user-friendly.

# **The current frustration**

Requesting documents (often called a PBC list – “Provided By Client” list) can be a nightmare:

1. **Confusing User Interface:**
   * Clients often need training just to see what’s outstanding and upload a document.
2. **Unorganized Sample Requests:**
   * For example, a client might receive a request with an Excel file listing 25 expenses, each expense needing multiple pieces of evidence (like invoices and bank statements).
   * They must gather and upload all evidence into an unorganized folder. This disorganization leads to many mistakes and re-work that can be prevented.
   * Auditors often take days—or even weeks—to review documents provided by the client; they must match each file to its correct item in the sample. Any missing or incorrect evidence requires re-work from the client.
3. **Constant Follow-Ups & Strained Relationships:**
   * Every missing document adds friction, but the longer it takes for clients to learn about mistakes, the more pain it causes.
   * Hours are lost chasing missing documents, leaving clients feeling nagged and auditors drained.

This **painful status quo** has been accepted as “just part of auditing” for far too long. Clients dread it, and firms worry that each request for info might annoy their client. The result? A process that should be straightforward often drags on with frustration on both sides.

# **The purpose-built solution**

What if providing audit evidence required zero training—and even felt satisfying? Enter Agentive’s new request flow, purpose-built to eliminate friction in auditing.

1. **Request with Samples**
   * **Native Itemized Requests:** Instead of downloading an Excel file to view the items in the sample, Agentive natively integrates the sample table into the request.
   * **Precise Uploads:** Clients attach specific evidence at the intersection of each sample row and document request column—eliminating guesswork and simplifying review.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88440&key=user_uploads/1097859/c3416ec7-7d91-4d2f-a49e-bd39a4474dbe)

2. **Engagement Board View**
   * **Instant Visibility:** Both auditors and clients see requests by status and category at a glance with drag and drop updates.
   * **Satisfaction:** Clients enjoy checking off completed items, ensuring everyone knows what’s done and what’s outstanding.
3. **Auditor Review Improvements**
   * **Flexible Upload**: Whether clients upload files one-by-one or in bulk, AI matches each document to the correct sample item—even in multi-page scans.
   * **Instant Citations**: Every value is automatically located within uploaded documents, with one-click navigation to its exact location.
   * **90% Faster Review**: AI-powered matching, detail testing, and analysis, let auditors quickly spot missing or insufficient documentation, slashing follow-up time with client.

Imagine your next audit kickoff: your client opens Agentive and says, **“Oh, this is nice!”** Instead of groans and procrastination, they begin right away—confident about what you need. Each step is transparent and even rewarding as they see their progress. What once felt like pulling teeth becomes a smooth collaboration.

# **Available Now: AI-Drafted Audit Procedures**

**In this post, our focus is on you and your clients**, and making sure the foundation of every audit – collaborating with the client – is as smooth and organized as possible. As former auditors, we’re equally dedicated to improving auditor job satisfaction. We do this by listening to you, our users, and solving your problems with **human-centered design** and **artificial intelligence.** Every document uploaded in a client request can easily be transformed into your firm’s audit workpaper template through our **AI-powered** document matching and AI prompts. We’re incredibly proud these workflows are set up in a few clicks and workpapers are ready for review in less than a minute after every client upload.

# **Ready to Delight Your Clients?**

[**Schedule a demo**](https://goagentive.com/) or email [founders@goagentive.com](mailto:founders@goagentive.com) to see how Agentive can elevate your firm for both clients and auditors.

launches.title: Agentive: AI-powered copilot for auditors
launches.tagline: We help accountants analyze financial records, perform audit procedures, and draft documentation in seconds.
launches.body:
Hi everyone, we’re Agentive.

**TL;DR** Agentive helps auditors unlock growth by shortening the time to perform audits. Auditors use our AI-powered copilot to analyze financial records, perform audit procedures, and draft documentation with 10x efficiency. If you’re an auditor, get in touch at [goagentive.com](http://goagentive.com)!

**Problem**

Audit staff spend 40% of their time searching, extracting, and manipulating data during audit procedures. And another 20% is spent preparing audit documentation. While it’s gotten easier to work with evidence provided by clients over the years thanks to OCR and other semi-automation solutions, it’s still painful. These audit procedures are rather standardized across clients and documentation is often identical year over year at the same client with only the current year data changing. The desire of audit staff to be involved in audit strategy is often in conflict with the amount of manual work that needs to be done at firms. This contributes to the high turnover in audit staff and the shortage of accountants entering the profession.

**Team**

While working as an auditor at EY, Danny Alberson felt underutilized due to the repetitive work involved in auditing. Nathan Turnbow, co-founder and CTO, built the first AI-powered education platform at Imagine Learning and honed his risk expertise as a cyber security engineer at Dell. Jason Draper, technical co-founder, led teams as an officer in the US Air Force and is a second time founder. Together, they're building Agentive to help auditors automate procedures and spend more time on audit strategy.

**Solution**

Agentive addresses this challenge by training large language models that cater to accounting and audit use cases. Agentive provides an in-browser spreadsheet editor and document viewer where auditors use natural language to have Agentive’s copilot analyze evidence, perform procedures, and draft documentation with 10x efficiency. It’s like working with ChatGPT during your audit. To review AI generated data we make it really easy to trace results back to their source. This not only speeds up preparing documents by audit staff but increases the efficiency of management and partner reviews as well.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72821&key=user_uploads/1097859/d436827f-1dd3-4314-a1d3-af9f37364114)

**What can you use Copilot for?**

1. **Extracting Text/Tables**: Extract text and data from documents like PDFs which can then be analyzed or moved to spreadsheets or workpapers for further processing.
2. **Compliance Checking**: Analyze the content of documents to check compliance with various regulations, standards, or policies, and provide reports detailing any areas of non-compliance.
3. **Content Search and Retrieval**: Enables auditors to conduct advanced content searches within documents, including searching for specific phrases, keywords, or patterns and retrieving relevant sections.
4. **Natural Language Querying**: Simplify data retrieval by extracting information from spreadsheets using natural language queries without complex formulas.
5. **Reconciliations**: Validate data within documents by cross-referencing it with other sources, such as spreadsheets, and highlight any discrepancies that require further investigation.
6. **Natural Language Summarization:** Automatically generate concise written summaries of financial data in spreadsheets, helping auditors quickly comprehend key insights without digging through raw data.

**Ask**

We’d love to connect with auditors! Please sign up for a demo at [goagentive.com](http://goagentive.com)

launches.body:
[VectorShift](http://www.vectorshift.ai/) is a no-code AI automations platform. Teams leverage AI through VectorShift’s no-code interface to search through knowledge bases, automate workflows, and deploy AI chatbots and assistants without needing to code or having knowledge about AI. 

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t18ySXNDYvs>

**VectorShift Platform**

Through drag-and-drop components, VectorShift’s no-code builder allows you to: 

* Use a flexible “visual programming language” to prototype, build, deploy, and manage LLM apps.
* Allow AI workflows to leverage a knowledge base with your data (e.g., files, documents, website). Knowledge bases can live-sync with your data wherever it sits (e.g., Google Drive, OneDirve, Notion, etc.).
* Define triggers that automatically run workflows (e.g., Slack message / Email) and allow workflows to perform actions (e.g., write a notion document).

launches.title: Trayd 🏗️ Construction payroll designed for same-day pay
launches.tagline: Trayd reinvents traditional construction payroll, creating financial opportunity for subcontractors and their workers.
launches.body:
### **TL;DR:**

Trayd is reinventing construction payroll for the betterment of all key players. For commercial real estate subcontractors, Trayd generates back office efficiencies with a platform that manages workforce attendance and payroll. For workers, Trayd offers instant access to their earned wages. Win-Win.

We are Anna Berger and Cara Kessler, the team behind @Trayd and we are on a mission to digitize construction payroll in order to power a better financial future for subcontractors and their workers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73344&key=user_uploads/1435469/811e72a1-0fc1-4b73-ab24-27b7ed95567f)

### 🚨**Problem**🚨

Within commercial real estate, demand for work is at an all-time high. In the last year, total construction spend in New York City reached $86BN and it keeps on climbing. That said, construction subcontractors are ill-equipped to handle the influx of work, with only 17% of them using digital tools to manage their back office. This lack of tech adoption is leading to work stoppages and high attrition, resulting in major revenue loss.

To make matters worse, construction employment still lags behind pre-covid levels. Of those that remain, highly skilled workers are choosing to leave the trades in search of more control over their cash flow, for example, gig economy jobs that allow them to work when they want and get paid instantly.

### **🏗️ Our Solution** 🏗️

Trayd is new type of construction payroll platform, designed to incentivize all key players. Through a closed loop system, Trayd tracks workers’ daily attendance in order to power real-time payroll automation. By merging time and payroll data into one system, subcontractors save tens of hours a week on manual back office work. As an added bonus, because Trayd authenticates attendance in real-time, Trayd can offer instant payment options to the workforce.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73344&key=user_uploads/1435469/5ed2d168-f70d-4752-b949-09d093ba8d81)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73344&key=user_uploads/1435469/92cdb561-b705-4aca-9ce1-c33f875435b9)

### 📖 **The Backstory** 📖

Born into a construction family and close to the problems that plague subcontractors and workers on a daily basis, our team is excited to modernize construction back office operations while simultaneously offering financial tools and opportunities to subcontractors and workers.

### **Asks 🙏**

* Know anyone in the construction industry? We’d love to speak to any general contractors, subcontractors, construction workers, or developers about their day-to-day experiences. Send any leads to [anna@buildtrayd.com](mailto:anna@buildtrayd.com)

If you have any questions, reach out! We’d love to hear from you.

* **Intimidating**: Mastering Excel formulas takes years

Professionals spend countless hours battling spreadsheets instead of focusing on decision-making.

**Investment bankers & consultants don’t use PowerPoint like you do:**

For most investment banking or consulting projects, the final deliverable is a PowerPoint deck.

 

To make sure the final draft of that deck is perfect, it goes through multiple rounds of review, feedback, & edits.

 

This means that many bankers and consultants spend hours squinting at different decks to see if the footnote on pg. 57 was updated correctly or if all the companies in a table on pg. 34 have uniform EBITDA adjustments.

 

Small details matter a lot, so teams often have to check over hundred-page decks from scratch. This review process is tedious & prone to mistakes.

 

**Track deck & model changes with one click:**

 

Carousel is a PowerPoint & Excel add-in that captures all the changes made to your team’s materials from shell to client PDF.

 

**Carousel tells you exactly WHO changed WHAT and WHEN.** With one click, the add-in highlights everything that changed between any two versions of the model or deck (in your current window, without having to open another file).

launches.tagline: We use LLMs to automate the core workflows of accounting firms.
launches.body:
# **TL;DR**

Tabular uses AI to automate the core workflows of accounting firms, starting in Europe. We generate zero-touch bookings on top of existing accounting software. This involves a range of tasks like classifying documents, determining VAT filings and selecting the correct booking accounts.

# **Problem: manual work x acute labour shortage**

Our customers use Tabular to save time on manual tasks, helping them address the acute labor shortage. Much of SMB accounting is still done by hand, but every second accounting firm has unfilled positions, causing them to lose out on revenue. Customers tell us they reject 5-10 new clients every week and have to drop existing ones whenever a bookkeeper retires. 

# **Why now? LLMs are a game changer for accounting**

For the first time, LLMs allow us to offer a step change in automation, reducing the time it takes to do an SMB’s book from hours to minutes. Previous generations of AI struggled with the highly variable and unstructured nature of SMB accounting data – but LLMs excel at precisely these tasks. Their ability to ingest large amounts of context about the nature of the business and transaction at hand, allows them to accurately reason through the many small accounting decisions required for every invoice. 

# **Solution: Accounting Autopilot**

Our first product is an accounts payables autopilot sitting on top of incumbent accounting software.  Users bulk upload hundreds of invoices. We sort through the documents, analyse the tax situation, and generate finished bookings. After reviewing edge cases, users export the books with just one click. Our product is already saving time for accounting firms in Germany:

> _As a modern firm, we need to use the most innovative software. Tabular saves us hours each week by automating split receipts and complex wholesaler invoices from the very first use._

\- Tim Kieserling from [HeyTax,](https://www.hey-tax.de/) a 40-person firm

He previously worked on launching new financial services at the European fintech unicorn [Trade Republic](https://traderepublic.com/en-de) (backed by Sequoia, Founders Fund, Creandum).

[**Kilian**](https://linkedin.com/in/kilian-j) - launched tax filing products in two new markets at [Taxfix](https://taxfix.de/en/) (Index, TGV) as a product manager and was employee #1 at [genova.ai](http://genova.ai), a B2C AI product studio. He studied at Williams College and Oxford.

Signature to Revenue, _Automatically_

launches.title: 🔎 SheetWhiz: The Best Way to Audit Your Google Spreadsheets
launches.tagline: The most powerful Trace Precedents tool for Google Sheets. As AI generates more formulas, SheetWhiz helps you trace, verify, and catch mistakes before they lead to bad decisions.
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103832&key=user_uploads/993872/5a9b468b-3cb9-4b3f-a355-6d7c3b5a9659)

## TL;DR

AI is going to generate more of your spreadsheet analysis.

That is powerful, but it creates a new problem: if AI writes the analysis, who catches the mistakes?

SheetWhiz helps you audit the logic behind your spreadsheet work before you rely on it. You can trace where numbers come from, understand how formulas flow through your model, verify that calculations make sense, and catch mistakes before they lead to bad decisions.

Under the hood, SheetWhiz gives you the most powerful Trace Precedents and Trace Dependents workflow in Google Sheets, with multi-level formula tracing, step-by-step formula evaluation, and AI built into the audit flow.

SheetWhiz is already used by over 10,000 professionals at some of the most productive companies in the world, including Anthropic, DoorDash, Robinhood, Chime, and GitLab.

Try SheetWhiz free from the Chrome Web Store.

## The Problem

AI is making it easier than ever to create spreadsheet analysis.

It can write formulas, build models, summarize data, and automate workflows that used to take hours. That is a huge productivity unlock, especially for teams that live in spreadsheets.

But it also creates a new risk: people will start shipping analysis they do not fully understand.

And even the best AI-generated spreadsheet work still needs review.

Wall Street Prep recently tested leading AI tools for financial modeling against investment banking standards. Even the winning tool scored only **5.7 / 10** on accuracy of data extraction, formatting, and modeling best practices, and **5.0 / 10** on quality and rigor of forecasting and model structure.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103832&key=user_uploads/993872/d615388a-d070-4bbe-8a3b-82dede469baf)

_Source: [https://www.wallstreetprep.com/knowledge/ranking-the-best-ai-tools-for-financial-modeling-2026](https://www.wallstreetprep.com/knowledge/ranking-the-best-ai-tools-for-financial-modeling-2026/)_

That does not mean AI is not useful. It means AI can help generate the first draft, but humans still need to inspect the logic before relying on the output.

The dangerous part is that the final output can look credible.

When AI generates a formula, the formula may look sophisticated. The model may look complete. The analysis may look ready to send. But unless someone can inspect the logic, trace the inputs, and explain how the number was calculated, the work is not truly understood.

Don’t be the person who puts your name on analysis you cannot defend.

Not when the numbers matter.

## The Most Powerful Trace Precedents Workflow for Google Sheets

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=10-XhrwDmo4>

SheetWhiz is built around the spreadsheet audit workflow people actually need: select a formula, understand where it came from, inspect the logic, fix issues, and keep working.

With Trace Precedents, you can select any formula and instantly see every cell feeding into it. You can jump directly to each source cell, move through references with your keyboard, and expand the precedents of those precedent cells to trace the formula multiple levels deep.

Instead of manually hunting through tabs and cell references, SheetWhiz gives you an interactive audit trail for your spreadsheet.

You can see where a number came from, what it depends on, and how it flows through the model.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103832&key=user_uploads/993872/13edeec1-e48b-4fcd-9d50-89a2fda13ec0)

But tracing cells is only the first step. The harder part is understanding what the formula is actually doing.

That is why SheetWhiz also has the Evaluates Formulas and Groups toggle.

If you are looking at a VLOOKUP, SheetWhiz can show the lookup value, the table being searched, the return column, and the exact value the function returns. Instead of manually counting columns and checking ranges, you can see the result of the lookup immediately.

If you are looking at INDEX/MATCH, SheetWhiz can break apart what MATCH is finding and what INDEX is returning. You can see which row or column was matched, which source cell was returned, and how the final result was calculated.

This matters because AI-generated formulas often look correct at a glance. They can use advanced functions, nested logic, and ranges that appear reasonable. But the only way to trust the output is to inspect what each part is doing.

SheetWhiz makes that inspection fast.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103832&key=user_uploads/993872/bc42a520-8757-4429-9d96-4d528a22c9fa)

## AI Built Into the Audit Workflow

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103832&key=user_uploads/993872/4d36128a-3af3-4ab4-a05b-75ee1a7ae8e7)

We layered AI directly into tracing.

That does not just mean generic formula explanations. SheetWhiz has the context of your spreadsheet, the selected cell, the referenced cells, the formula being evaluated, and the surrounding model or analysis. If you’re building an LBO, SheetWhiz AI knows you’re building an LBO and will let you know whether your returns analysis is calculating correctly based on that model.

In a data analysis, SheetWhiz can explain the mechanics of the formula. If you are not familiar with VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, LET, or another function, you can ask what the formula is doing, how it works, and whether anything looks off.

That is the workflow we think people need as AI writes more spreadsheet work:

Generate the work, then inspect it, understand it, and verify it before you rely on it.

## Other Auditing Tools

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103832&key=user_uploads/993872/4576c408-a4cb-46fe-a2f2-9cd9c2ed14fa)

Trace Precedents is the core workflow, but SheetWhiz also includes other tools to help you inspect and audit spreadsheets faster.

With Trace Dependents, you can see which formulas rely on the cell you are changing. Before editing an input, assumption, or formula, you can understand what downstream calculations might be affected.

SheetWhiz also helps you visualize spreadsheet structure with auto-coloring. You can color hard-coded values, formulas, and links to other tabs so it is easier to see what is going on in a model at a glance.

For example, you can quickly distinguish hardcoded assumptions from linked cells and formulas, making it easier to review a model for consistency and potential errors.

The goal is to help you catch problems before they spread through the model and become decisions.

## Built for People Who Actually Work in Sheets and Slides

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e2vizHjWNfE>

Auditing is only one part of spreadsheet work. Once you understand the model, you still need to clean it up, format it, present it, and move quickly.

That is why SheetWhiz includes over 100 spreadsheet and presentation shortcuts.

For people coming from Excel, SheetWhiz brings familiar Excel-style shortcuts into Google Sheets, including paste special, insert and delete rows or columns, autofit and set row height and column width, filters, borders, alignment, merge, freeze panes, and more.

For formatting-heavy work, SheetWhiz includes format cycling tools like number cycling, font cycling, fill color cycling, and indentation cycling.

For reporting workflows, SheetWhiz lets you export a selection as an image into Google Slides while preserving the formatting from your sheet. The image links back to the original source, so teammates can trace the screenshot back to where it came from.

SheetWhiz also includes Google Slides shortcuts, so the same speed gains carry into the deck-building process.

AI is useful when you want help thinking through a formula. But sometimes you do not want to type a prompt or wait for a response. You just want to move faster in the spreadsheet.

SheetWhiz gives you both.

## Why We Built It

Before building SheetWhiz, I worked in tech private equity at Silver Lake and later in finance and operations roles. Excel plus plugins were core to how I worked.

Moving into Google Sheets meant losing speed, visibility, and accuracy, especially when auditing formulas.

Google Sheets is great for collaboration, but it has historically lacked the formula tracing, auditing, formatting, and reporting workflows that spreadsheet-heavy teams rely on every day.

Now that AI is generating more spreadsheet work, that gap matters even more.

If AI writes the analysis, the human still needs to audit it.

That is what SheetWhiz is built for.

## Try SheetWhiz

SheetWhiz is free to try from the Chrome Web Store.

Join over 10,000 professionals at companies like Anthropic, DoorDash, Robinhood, Chime, and GitLab, and make your Google Sheets formulas easier to trace, understand, and trust.

# Dimely and SheetWhiz: Fixing Spreadsheet for Finance Teams

SheetWhiz emerged alongside Dimely, our AI connected spreadsheet, as part of the same mission: making the spreadsheet experience better for finance teams. Dimely focuses on automating your billing spreadsheet work, while SheetWhiz focuses on improving the daily tooling inside Google Sheets itself. Please reach out if interested in learning more about SheetWhiz or Dimely.

launches.tagline: Save hundreds of hours every month automating manual finance tasks.
launches.body:
**TL;DR: **[**Dimely**](https://dimely.co/)** automates and brings visibility to time-consuming, error-prone finance workflows so teams can stay lean, audit-ready, and fully informed. We integrate seamlessly with your existing tech stack — no rip-and-replace needed — so you start seeing results on Day 1.**

👋 Hi all - we’re [David](https://www.linkedin.com/in/davidnpang/) and [Peter,](https://www.linkedin.com/in/p2sun/) and we’re on a mission to save finance teams countless hours of tedious, manual work. After logging countless hours on billing tasks in our previous roles, we decided to build the AI agents we wish we had. Dimely handles the mundane chores, maintains a proper data trail, and keeps a human-in-the-loop to ensure **100% accuracy** and **audit readiness**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82959&key=user_uploads/993872/06c793df-f448-42bf-b06a-4bdda1bb6ce1)

# **❌ Problem: Billing for B2B SaaS is manual and error-prone**

This is because:

* **Contracts are complex.** Contracts have multiple SKUs, payment schedules, pricing models, and billing metrics
* **Contracts are unstructured.** Terms are often bespoke and written in by sales teams trying to close deals
* **Data lives in different places.** Usage-based pricing models in particular, require matching contract data in your CRM with usage data from your data warehouse that is not always accurate or structured in a way that works well for billing 
* **Finance needs are deprioritized.** Engineering typically prioritizes product building and deprioritizes finance initiatives
* **High finance tech debt.** Billing systems that work early on remain in place for too long because it takes 5+ months to migrate to another system, resulting in a high number of manual workarounds, typically in spreadsheets

# **🏁 Solution: Comprehensive, AI-driven platform to automate and bring visibility to complex finance processes.**

This is where [Dimely](https://dimely.co/) comes in. We take the tasks that take the most time and automate them while keeping you in the loop. Dimely’s primary areas of focus are:

**✅** Converting contracts to invoices

**✅** Reconciling invoices, contracts, entitlements, and payments

**✅** Calculating overages and invoicing customers (via your billing solution)

**✅** Setting up proper revenue recognition

What makes Dimely unique: 

* **High time to value.** We integrate within your existing workflows - no need to rip and replace anything
* **No engineers required.** Set up Dimely through our UI and with natural language
* **Flexible.** We know billing is heterogeneous, and various companies do things differently. Dimely’s AI copilot understands its workflows and won’t break if something unusual comes up

# **🎇 How it Works:**

Here’s a short demo of a fairly simple but time-consuming workflow where Dimely can assist: creating invoices in your billing solution based on signed contracts

<https://youtu.be/KtA8IlxfVTo>

# **📢 Our Ask:**

* Let us know if you know anyone spending significant time with billing. Specifically, Heads of Finance and Controllers at B2B SaaS startups. We’d love to [chat](https://calendly.com/david-pang-calendar/30min)
* Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/company/usedimely) - we have some pretty good content!

**tl;dr: **[**Thyme**](https://www.meetthyme.com/)** enables financial advisors to run 10x better meetings. We cover meeting prep, transcription, summarization, CRM syncing, and document parsing. Please introduce us to any financial advisor in your network!**

# 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 About us

We are Fernando San Martin (left), and Daniel Lantz (right). We've worked together at Capital One, trovata.io, Campfire (YC S23) and are now Thyme co-founders. Our mission is to build better software tools for financial advisors.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82372&key=user_uploads/847698/1370b41c-bff4-402b-be93-fc40ffa032cb)

# **❗ The Problem**

Financial advisors spend hours every day preparing, running, and following up on client meetings. Their attention is split between engaging with the client and taking meaningful notes, and often, these notes are incomplete or non-existent.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82372&key=user_uploads/847698/3e9d6239-57f1-4a34-b794-7223d5eef16b)

After finishing the meeting, the advisor has to expand on the few scattered words that they jotted down to create follow-up tasks and update their CRM with the new client insights.

# ✅ **Our Solution**

Thyme solves all of the above. Using our app, the advisor can see their upcoming meetings, for which they can prepare by viewing a holistic profile about the client and even asking natural language questions.

Once in the meeting, our app uses state-of-the-art AI technology to transcribe, summarize, generate action items, and draft follow-up emails.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82372&key=user_uploads/847698/554cca4a-0ea6-40f2-ad21-effa09f00d16)

Finally, our powerful integrations with the rest of the advisors’ tech stack also allow us to initiate workflows and send tasks and notes to other systems. Any financial documents submitted by the client are parsed and integrated into their profile.

Our users describe the solution as a game-changer that saves them hours each week while creating much richer and more accurate notes and tasks that sync seamlessly with their stack.

# 🙏 **Request**

* If you like what we are building, upvote, comment, and follow us on [Linkedin.](https://www.linkedin.com/company/thyme-yc-s24/)
* If you know of any financial advisors in your network, ask them if they would be interested in chatting. Here is a potential blurb you can use to introduce us: "[Thyme](https://www.meetthyme.com) is changing how financial advisors run online meetings. Would you like to hear more directly from the team?"

launches.body:
**Hi YC**

SOX testing is one of the most painful parts of being a public company. We built Midship to fix that.

Since launch, multiple public companies have onboarded and are already cutting weeks of testing work down to hours.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aV0c_OQlHeg

**The problem**

SOX testing is an extremely expensive and time-consuming part of being public.

Companies either:

* Spend millions outsourcing the work to consultants, or
* Burn thousands of internal hours doing testing and documentation manually

In both cases, the results are the same: auditors being pulled away from higher-value risk and strategy.

**The solution**

We built the first **end-to-end [SOX automation platform](https://midship.ai/sox)**.

Our AI agents handle the heavy lifting

* Running attribute tests like tie-outs and reconciliations across evidence
* Linking and annotating support so every conclusion is transparently documented
* Assembling audit-ready workpapers in the exact formats external auditors expect

We deliver this through the **two surfaces where SOX work happens**:

* A **web app** for managing tests and documentation

launches.title: Midship - AI for Financial Auditors
launches.tagline: Midship accelerates financial audit procedures with AI agents
launches.body:
Hi YC 🫡

We’re Kieran, Aahel and Max from Midship and we are building AI agents that accelerate financial audits. With Midship, you can go from a folder of 100 unorganized PDF documents to a draft work paper in minutes, rather than days.

Our agents target low-complexity, document based auditing tasks, such as matching invoices to ledger items and checking correctness of dates on receipts. They collect and link evidence at every step, making all work quickly verifiable.

Our launch video makes the bold claim that our platform will break up the stranglehold the Big 4 (Deloitte, EY, PWC, KPMG) have on the audit market:

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o-8_NwHYgCQ>

# **Problem**

**Everyone gets audited**

Every public company in the US requires a yearly audit of their financial statements by an accredited auditor. These require an auditor to gather evidence that a company’s financial statements are accurate and complete, to a reasonable level of assurance.

**Everything is a PDF**

As the auditor is external, getting the data invariably means receiving many PDFs of financial documents, such as invoices, purchase order and receipts. Until recently, there was no way to reliably extract and process the data from these documents, meaning a human had to go through each of the documents by hand.

**Audit workflows are painful**

Beyond the time spent on an individual audit, the audit profession as a whole is feeling the ramifications of these quality of life issues. One look at /r/accounting will show you the frustration auditors are feeling with long hours, especially during busy season (right now).

# **Solution**

With the advent of modern vision language models (VLMs), we can extract data from these financial documents and process them as if we had a direct integration with the clients accounting and ERP systems.

A task such as “find the correct invoice for each of these 50 samples” goes from hours of manual work to a few minutes of VLM processing.

We then go one level further with agents performing audit tests from plans written in natural language. For example, an auditor may plan to check that for each sample, “all amounts match between documents”. Midship performs this check, links to evidence in the source documents and highlights anything that requires review by an auditor.

**We have a web app:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88714&key=user_uploads/1473312/a66dd447-a22f-455b-b447-9375126e4159)

**And a native Excel add-in with all the same functionality:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88714&key=user_uploads/2088119/0dd68370-1716-43ba-b807-626af26c9551)

# **Our ask**

If you have worked with a **auditor from outside the Big-4** in a current or recent role, we would _love_ to talk to them.

Contact us at: [founders@midship.ai](mailto:founders@midship.ai)

launches.body:
# **TL;DR**

[Cardamon](https://cardamon.ai/) enables regulated financial firms to launch products, enter new markets and stay compliant 10X faster by automating regulatory mapping with AI. We cut the manual and repetitive tasks of sifting through 1000s of pages of regulation and analysing each passage - saving 100s of hours for regulated businesses. Check it out [here](https://youtu.be/EpE27zi-6JI).

**Ask:** If you’re spending time & money trying to figure out what regulations apply, send us a message at [hello@cardamon.ai](mailto:hello@cardamon.ai) - we are already helping several firms cut 100s of hours from regulatory mapping work, enabling them to launch products faster

# **The Problem ❌**

Financial firms face a host of complex regulations that make it incredibly painful to launch and maintain products in a compliant way. As a Product team at Revolut, we felt this pain deeply ourselves - we had products ready to launch but were stuck in compliance limbo, often for weeks. Turns out, getting compliant took as long as building the product itself.

Frustrated, we dug in and were shocked by how manual and inefficient the processes were. Compliance teams would have to sift through 1000s of pages of different regulations, which they would need to understand, review and transpose into product requirements, controls & policies. These processes today are almost entirely manual, taking up hundreds of hours a year per compliance employee.

# **Our** **Solution ✅**

Cardamon is an AI powered platform that ingests relevant regulation, understands what applies to each regulated financial firm, and gets compliance officers from regulation, to obligations, to product requirements in minutes - not weeks. 

Compliance officers can select any regulation they want to map to their firm. Cardamon goes through every line and evaluates:

* What is applicable
* What is an obligation 
* What the impact is
* What the associated risks types are

 

Additionally, there is the option to generate controls for the obligations and query the underlying regulations with specific questions. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87846&key=user_uploads/2331736/d0972346-1b82-4c70-bd3a-1220e3ef8730)

Importantly, compliance officers remain in full control with a host of features enabling them to edit, save and even download the mapping as a CSV.

launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

Trata gives hedge funds un-biased, unfiltered stock analysis from anonymous Analysts at well-known funds. Our AI agents interview Analysts at multi-billion dollar funds, capture their thinking about the stocks they know and publish it anonymously.

### **Problem:**

1. It takes buyside Analysts at least 3 hours to figure out a company’s key narratives/points of debate - what outcomes are going to drive the share price up OR down? Examples: an ongoing lawsuit, a competitor going bankrupt, an Activist campaign, a new CEO, etc. This involves reading earnings call transcripts, initiation reports, talking to Investor Relations, reaching out to other Analysts, and piecing everything together yourself.
2. Because of the time it takes to do step 1, would-be winners/inflection points fall through the cracks all the time.
3. Current solutions (idea dinners, forums like Value Investors Club, Twitter DMs, independent research boutiques and even paid Substacks) are fragmented and biased.
4. The highest quality leads come from talking directly to fellow Analysts, but there’s never been a way to do this at scale, authentically. Until now.

### **Solution:**

We use LLMs to interview dozens of people a day, get their quick and honest takes on signals/points of debate they’re actually paying attention to, and turn that into a one-of-a-kind research product. Each conversation is with an anonymous hedge fund Analyst who is deeply familiar with the company – think an expert network where the hedge funds are the experts. Contributors share their knowledge to gain access to an exponentially bigger pool of expertise.

We don’t provide investment advice; we just get you up to speed – fast. We work directly with the compliance teams of multi-billion dollar hedge funds and have a team of human lawyers to ensure SEC compliance.

We are building the product I wish I had as an Analyst. Our first user interviews liked the idea so much (without any code built) that they are now our angels.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gE_Ovy1BiTM>

### **Here’s how to think about our value proposition:**

If a fund manages $300 million, one successful idea (3% position, +50% return) generates $4.5 million in profit and $900K in fees ($720/180K split between the Portfolio Manager and Analyst). This is a 750X, 120X, and 30X ROI on a $6K subscription for the Fund, Portfolio Manager and Analyst.

All it takes is one decent idea for Trata to be a home run.

### **Our Ask:**

If you are a hedge fund Analyst or know any hedge fund Analysts / public investors, please reach out! They don't have to be at a big fund like Citadel for us to be interested. We pay very well. They will most likely thank you for the intro. We guarantee anonymity. Contact us at [founders@trytrata.com](mailto:founders@trytrata.com).

### **Our Team’s Story:**

Eric and Will met at Cornell as undergrads. Eric and Alex met in high school English and grew up in the same hometown.

[Eric](https://www.linkedin.com/in/emc329/): 4.5 years as a Senior Analyst at a Long/Short Hedge Fund covering tech companies globally. Applied Economics (summa cum laude) at Cornell. Posts on Value Investors Club for fun, Sohn Idea Contest Finalist in 2021, has traveled to 20+ countries in the past few years.

[Will](https://www.linkedin.com/in/william-m-gao/): UChicago PhD Student (ML/AI). Research Scientist Intern at Meta’s Reality Labs, Nvidia’s Deep Imagination Lab, and Adobe Research. Full-time ML Engineer at Meta. CS/Stats/Math triple major in three years and a Master’s in CS his fourth year at Cornell. Globally ranked in certain online video games.

[Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexanderqchen/): Senior Software Engineer at Titan (YC S18, Series C backed by a16z), Engineer 7 at Medallion (Series C backed by Sequoia), Software Engineer at Oscar Health a year before its IPO. launches.title: Fira MCP: Financial datasets in Claude and Excel
launches.tagline: Connect SEC filings, UK Companies House, market data and earnings transcripts to your AI with source-cited answers
launches.body:
Reliable financial data access and trust in outputs are still the bottleneck in adopting AI in banking, consulting and investment firms. We built Fira MCP to solve that, starting from for teams adopting Claude. Our data connector lets your AI read and cite SEC and international filings, UK Companies House, market data, and earnings transcripts. It works with Claude, Claude for Excel, ChatGPT, and Copilot, while setup takes 3 minutes and it's free to try - <https://firaresearch.com/mcp>.

<https://youtu.be/JoEY1imdVhw>

### Problem

Many banking, consulting, and investment firms are moving day-to-day AI work to Claude. But reliable data access and trust in the outputs are still the bottleneck.

### Solution - Fira MCP

Fira MCP plugs directly into Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and Claude for Excel as a data connector. Your AI gets access to filings, transcripts, and market data, with numbers linked back to the exact paragraph or row in the source document. It handles scanned PDFs, nested tables, and works across tens of documents in a single research thread.

## Available datasets

* **SEC Filings** — 8,000+ active US companies (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, and more)
* **UK Companies House** — 5M+ private companies, including scanned accounts
* **International filings** — 10,000+ companies across 50+ countries
* **Earnings call transcripts** — full transcripts with analyst Q&A
* **Market data** — 20+ years of daily stock and FX, US and global
* **Custom datasets** — proprietary and third-party integrations for enterprise

### Use cases

**I. Peer comparison in Excel** — pull financials, strategy, and risk factors across competitors directly from filings.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100809&key=user_uploads/626328/99b5fdce-2a4b-4053-a6c1-6b94ec87d578)

**II. Corporate structure mapping** — trace ownership and financials through complex group structures from UK filings.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100809&key=user_uploads/626328/c1665625-8a07-414d-ac76-b7ecd356b12b)

**III. Earnings call analysis** — review management commentary and analyst Q&A for sentiment and evasive answers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100809&key=user_uploads/626328/7fb98502-0b18-4486-b7f7-5b6655161588)

**IV. Document verification** — cross-reference every number against source, catch rounding deltas and inconsistencies.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100809&key=user_uploads/626328/c11d5c2d-d1d3-4328-a4bb-63dd13aba8d6)

### Asks

Looking to connect with finance professionals (banking, PE, credit, hedge funds, wealth) who want their AI assistant to actually do useful work.

launches.body:
**Fira** is building an agentic AI analyst for financial research and automation, starting with UK investment firms. Today, we accelerate analysts with source-cited insights and verified calculations from complex company filings.

<https://youtu.be/a8C9TifdUOg>

# Problem

Analysts at investment banks and boutique M&A firms waste tons of time digging through hundred-page annual reports to prepare pitch decks and models. General LLM tools aren't good enough for the job — lacking accuracy, domain-specific data, and output verification. The problem extends to senior professionals who need to quickly understand new topics deeply while staying grounded in truthful data sources.

---

# Solution

Fira saves analysts time by instantly searching, analyzing and citing UK company filings. It reads multiple filings and reports (including 500 page long and scanned documents) to provide source-cited answers and verifiable calculations. We cover hundreds of public UK companies, integrate with Companies House for private company data, and allow to upload your documents.

---

# Use cases

**I. Breakdown detailed financial and operational KPIs in seconds**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88048&key=user_uploads/626328/d03ed2eb-89ea-49f2-af3e-895cf89dd3a7)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88048&key=user_uploads/626328/af63b5d1-c1ba-4551-9168-91c8b3a8ca8f)

Looking to connect with senior professionals and analysts at investment banks, M&A advisory firms, hedge funds, and wealth management firms. Especially in the UK. If you work in finance or know someone who does, we'd love an intro. Book a demo [here](https://firaresearch.com) or email us at [alex@firaresearch.com](mailto:alex@firaresearch.com).

Alexey and Alex are both technical founders, met 9 years ago at university and been close friends since.

Alexey was CTO and co-founder of [resume.io](http://resume.io), one of the largest resume builder websites (acquired in 2021). He’s also an author of wouter, a React router library with 7k stars and 580k downloads/month, and a regular tech conference speaker.

Alex was the founder and CEO of Hashscan, on-chain user analytics startup. Previously, he built a popular crypto porftolio tracker app Hodler (sold in 2022).

Hi everyone 👋 we’re [Peter](https://www.linkedin.com/in/zhudanmeng/) & [Om](https://www.linkedin.com/in/om-agarwal/). We’re building the future of accounting.

**TL;DR**

**Minerva:** Automated, end-to-end business accounting—at a fraction of the cost.

* **Seamless data capture:** Instantly syncs with Email, WhatsApp, Stripe, Shopify, Drive and any platform where money moves.
* **Zero manual work:** From transaction categorization through bookkeeping and reconciliation to tax-ready reports and filings.
* **Smart tax guidance:** Real-time insights and personalized strategies to minimize liabilities and boost cash flow.

**_Ask:_**\_ Need accurate, instant accounting services? Email: [om@tryminerva.ai](https://mailto:om@tryminerva.ai) or [book a demo here](https://cal.com/omagarwal/30min).

**Launch video**

<https://youtu.be/ntPnAkXBJ9E>

**What we do**

We believe accountants will not exist in 10 years. AI has just now made it possible to automate almost every single task they do, and we are here to capitalize on that. We aim to replace all bookkeeping, accounting and tax filing jobs within small businesses globally.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90474&key=user_uploads/699602/a3d4cbc1-3f96-4b78-a0ee-87bd139773c5)

Traditional software (Quickbooks/Xero) can’t think, and traditional accountants (Fondo/Finta) can’t scale—we need something more.

Minerva delivers CFO-level intelligence through AI—ready to ingest every bank feed, invoice, chat, and doc. It is the most agentic accountant you will ever have.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90474&key=user_uploads/699602/c9e3451a-5601-44c8-af81-4d119e8ff2fd)

**Minerva is a CFO-grade, AI-powered accounting service that:**

* **Ingests everything.** Pulls bank feeds, invoices, chats, docs—then learns your revenue streams and approval quirks automatically.
* **Writes the follow-ups.** Auto-emails vendors, customers, or teammates to chase receipts, fix POs, or renegotiate terms—politely and persistently.
* **Answers instantly.** Type “burn-rate trend” or “campaign ROI” and get audit-ready numbers plus a plain-English blurb.
* **Autopilots your P&L.** Spots gaps in real time, pings the right person, and reconciles the moment data lands—no month-end scramble.
* **Looks forward, not back.** Runs live 13-week cash forecasts, Monte-Carlo stress tests, and hiring “what-ifs,” refreshing every few minutes.
* **Turns regulations into refunds.** Tracks global tax codes, surfaces every credit or deduction, prepares the forms, and e-files on time.
* **Optimizes cash like a treasury desk.** Sweeps idle balances into high-yield accounts, times payments for float and discounts, and flags financing options before gaps appear.
* **Tells the story.** Auto-builds board decks, KPI dashboards, and investor memos—charts, insights, even voice-overs included.
* **Stays audit-ready.** Maintains a time-stamped evidence vault and runs continuous mock audits.
* **Learns on its own.** Each close cycle sharpens categorization and forecasts—no upgrades needed.
* **Integrates everywhere.** From Stripe to Shopify, Slack to WhatsApp—if it holds financial signal, it’s in scope.

**The Team**

[@Peter Zhu](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/317122) (left), [@Om Agarwal](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/699602) (right). We’re from Canada & met at an international science fair during high school. We have been building together ever since! We both have 2 decades of combined experience building software.

launches.title: sieve helps hedge funds extract and clean data from any source directly into their existing tools
launches.tagline: Focus on differentiated analyses and never think about data cleaning again
launches.body:
**The problem**

Right now, the most sophisticated hedge funds pay over-qualified data engineers to spend hours a day on the under-levered task of data cleaning. It's crazy to anyone outside of the industry, but in finance even earnings dates (the date a company reports earnings) are considered **a known hard problem.**

https://youtu.be/V-OpzDRge3o

**Our ask**

We've solved this problem and our ask to the YC community is - **connect us with anyone you know who works in the investing world and uses data (should be all of them).** You can email us at [founders@usesieve.com](mailto:nicole@usesieve.com).

**Who we are**

After studying CS at MIT, I worked at Citadel and McKinsey, and Savannah worked at Bain. We've dealt with this problem first hand and were amazed that there weren't good solutions.

**What we've built**

sieve lets hedge funds replace manual review in their data pipelines with a simple API call, so their engineers and analysts can get back to more differentiated work. Behind the scenes, we use AI to find and retrieve the appropriate source documents and to extract the requested data. Each data point is reviewed by a team of expert reviewers before being returned to the client. This lets us achieve the level of accuracy hedge funds need, and that AI-only approaches aren't able to achieve.

We offer direct API access and access via other tools like Excel. Watch below to see how the excel integration works!

[**https://youtu.be/r6A1t_X2kZo**](https://youtu.be/r6A1t_X2kZo)

**What the early results look like**

* sieve is able to replace manual data cleaning workflows:
  * accurately (100% match to data that was hand-collected internally)
  * more scalably (weeks of full-time work to review data became a passive background task for the data scientist)
  * more cheaply (easily 60-70% cheaper than existing options, even when that existing option is BPO outsourcing)

In our first week of YC, we were told that we need to be at least one of: better, faster, or cheaper.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
We all combine deep domain expertise in mid-market and enterprise workflow automation. 

Lorenz and Jonas worked together for 4+ years at TradeLink (SCM-SaaS backed by Point Nine, Insight), accompanying the path from 0 to product-market fit. Lorenz led Product; Jonas led Go-to-Market. Both quit their leadership roles to found Finto. 

Knowing each other from the Munich startup scene, Linus joined as Co-Founder & CTO. He was previously an early tech lead at Tacto (Procurement SaaS backed by Sequoia, Index), helping scale it from pre-seed to one of Europe’s largest Series A rounds in mid-market SaaS.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Enterprises with complex vendor supply chains produce vast amounts of incoming vendor invoices each year. A typical **mid-market enterprise processes \~100k incoming invoices** **yearly**, and today, an accountant tops out at \~10-20k invoices per year because the real grind is still manual: 

* Key-stroking invoice data to the ERP
* Manual invoice review and compliance checks
* Manual managing deviations with purchase orders
* Manual allocate ledger accounts and cost center codes
* Chasing approvals. That’s why enterprises still staff large accounting teams - or ship the work to shared-service centers.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
AI will write the final chapter of accounting software. What once required teams, training, and manual effort now happens in real-time - intelligently, autonomously, and at scale through agents. 

Finto is our contribution to this future. As AI agents become capable of understanding context, learning from company-specific data, and executing complex workflows, entire job profiles will shift away from manual execution. With its predictable but intricate schemes, accounting is poised to be one of the first areas transformed. 

Doubling down on our domain expertise, we are on a mission to **take the manual out of accounting**.

**Finto - AI Accounting for Enterprises**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=otqOvfepgKQ

**TL;DR**

Finto builds an AI accounting software for enterprise finance teams. We automate the invoice-to-pay process from their email inbox to their ERP including invoice handling, supplier communication, 3-way matching, and ERP data entry.

**Problem**

Enterprises with complex vendor supply chains produce vast amounts of incoming vendor invoices each year. A typical **mid-market enterprise processes \~100k incoming invoices** **yearly**, and today’s legacy tools force accountants to top out at a fraction of the volume: Real manual grunt work still remains:

* Handling hundreds of mails and documents a day
* Key-stroking invoice data to the ERP
* Manual invoices checks and account coding
* Manual managing deviations with purchase orders
* Chasing approvals

That’s why enterprises still staff large accounting teams - or ship the work to shared-service centers. Our mission is to free the world’s finance teams from repetitive, low-value tasks so they can focus on impactful work. That starts with building a place where everyone can do their best work.

We build a platform embedding AI agents to automate the end-to-end invoice-to-pay cycle:

1. **Classify** inbox documents (invoice, receipts, reminder)
2. **Read** invoices at **99%+ accuracy** - even on line item level

6. **Three-Way-Match** invoice orders with POs and GRs
7. **Collect** **&** **chase** required approvals
8. **Post to ERP**

launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We’re [Evan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/evanameyer/) and [Jeet](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeetchugh/) – co-founders of [Mod AI](https://usemod.ai).

# **TL;DR**

**Mod AI automates the manual work of processing invoices for growing enterprises.** We’ve already helped accounting teams of 1-20+ streamline their invoice processing by 83%.

**_Ask:_** Can you introduce us to CFOs, controllers, Accounting Directors, or Accounts Payable managers of mid to large companies that could benefit from streamlining their accounting processes with AI? Contact us at [evan@mod-ai.org](mailto:evan@mod-ai.org)

https://youtu.be/XaT6mEQnWmE

# ❌ The Problem

Most growing enterprises still process invoices manually—hiring AP clerks to comb through inboxes, type up documents, and chase approvals. As volume grows, they scramble to add more headcount or outsource to expensive temps.

This creates three major pains:

1. **Cash flow blindness** – No visibility until month-end close
2. **Unscalable manual work** – More invoices means more clerks (highest-turnover role in finance)
3. **Vendor relationship damage** – Late payments and errors erode trust

We talked to 23 CFOs last month—nearly all said their AP process couldn't scale.

# 👷 Our Solution

Mod AI deploys AI agents that handle your accounts payable process end-to-end—from the moment an invoice arrives to the moment it's paid and synced to your books. Companies simply connect their systems and instantly get:

* **Complete invoice capture** 📥**:** Auto-pull from email, supplier portals, EDI, physical mail
* **Intelligent processing** 🧠**:** 97%+ accurate GL coding, 2-way/3-way matching, fraud detection
* **Seamless approval & payment** ✅**:** Custom workflows, one-click approvals, direct sync to accounting software

**Result:** Real-time spend visibility, 10x invoice volume without hiring, and stronger vendor relationships.

# 🙏 Our Ask

If you answer "yes" to any of these, we'd love your help:

* **Do you know any mid-market CFOs, Controllers, or VP Finance leaders** whose AP teams are drowning in manual invoice work? Or are you one yourself? We'd love to show you a demo and discuss how Mod AI can help you scale without adding headcount.

# **Why we’re doing it**

Michael and Philip have worked on countless deals at McKinsey and in other IB/PE roles, and it always starts and ends with an Excel model. It’s either the main deliverable itself, or the entire backbone of the slide deck.

No matter how skilled you are, manual Excel modeling is slow and super error-prone. On one of our last projects, a company’s 2030 revenue projection presented to the CEO was doubled because a colleague (promise it was a colleague), had linked the forecast to year 1 revenue growth for all years. That was a fun follow-up call afterwards.

Associates need specialized AI tools they can collaborate with directly in their workflows, to drive productivity and accuracy. The solution is not to replace Excel, but to augment it and solve one pain point at a time. That’s why we’re building Crunched.

# **What we’re doing**

Crunched is an Excel-native AI analyst that can:

1. **_Error-check models:_** Check models for logical, formula and conceptual mistakes
2. **_Gather data:_** Run targeted web research and extract figures from PDFs (e.g., annual reports) and link it into templates
3. **_Build analyses:_** Build bespoke analyses from scratch, turning 1h tasks into 5-10min automated workflows

Hey everyone [👋](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand)

We’re Rishabh, Hrishi, Vivan, and Rakesh.\
We’re building AI associates that automate deal work for firms in the private capital markets.\
[_(demo video_](https://youtu.be/GN8JtPZ99z8)_)_

---

### **Problem**

Deal teams spend a surprisingly large amount of their time on repetitive processes:\
reviewing CIMs, rebuilding models, creating tear sheets and IC decks, updating CRMs and trackers, and piecing together context fragmented across file drives.

### **What We Do**

Zarna connects our **cohort of AI associates** to your firm’s history. _Past deals, the CRM, shared drives, board decks, third-party databases, etc._

Once connected, they execute core work end-to-end:

* Generate tear sheets, IOI materials, and IC drafts in the firm’s format
* Convert CIM financials into diligence model structures
* Complete all data entry & enrichment into [CRM](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8daMRb9IPxU)s
* Sync operator notes & portfolio KPI trackers over time
* Analyze CIMs, teasers, and market reports to surface what matters

**The goal is simple:**

With the summaries, models, and trackers handled, investors can spend their time forming deeper views on companies and markets — building conviction faster on the right deals.

---

### **Why Zarna**

Every firm has its **own way** of evaluating businesses, management, and risk.\
So **generic copilots fail**—they don’t understand the firm’s history, style, or decision-making patterns.

The hard part is **institutional memory and reasoning**, not text generation.

We embed forward-deployed engineers with deal teams to tune how the agents:

* interpret financial signals
* format materials
* map market structures
* reflect the firm’s voice and conviction process

This turns what used to live in **individuals who could walk out the door** into something **searchable, reusable, and cumulative across the firm.**

The result is not just “faster work.”\
It is **firms that start each deal loaded with context instead of from zero.**

---

### **Backstory**

Pre-YC, we were forward-deployed engineers embedded in a $20B private equity firm, leading AI enablement initiatives & building agents automation across sourcing, diligence, and portfolio management.

The four of us are best friends who have been building together since college. We studied computer science, electrical engineering, & economics at UC Berkeley. We’ve explored many ideas over the last 3 years — this is the one where we saw the **problem first-hand** and **couldn’t let go of it.**

**FullSeam is your AI-powered finance and accounting teammate.** 

FullSeam agents log into a company's existing accounting tools and perform routine tasks that accounts receivable and accounts payable teams usually do by hand - like communicating with vendors and customers, recording payments, and updating financial records.\

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97900&key=user_uploads/135383/6d1853f9-5cc5-4804-9644-e5ab59b94d90)

We realized accounting teams don’t need another dashboard — **they need teammates**.

FullSeam's AI agents plug into your ERP, billing system, and spreadsheets and take over repetitive, error-prone accounting and finance work – without changing how your team operates.

name: End Close
long_description:
End Close builds automatic reconciliation for payments companies like fintechs, marketplaces, banks and payroll companies. Reconciliation helps companies track every dollar and resolve every exception, ensuring they have no money loss, can report audit ready financials, and stay compliant.

Sean (CEO) spent the last 6 years building the reconciliation org at Modern Treasury (S18), processing a trillion dollars in payments across 40 banks with 99.995% automation. Fast growing companies like Modern Treasury are forced to build a solution in-house or buy a legacy solution. End Close provides a modern reconciliation system that works with a company's existing stack and is managed by AI agents.

Exception handling is where 99% of the manual work happens today, payment ops teams spend hours gathering context across various data sources to investigate each ticket. End Close provides an AI ops agent that connects to a company's data warehouse, invoicing platform and payment processors to triage and resolve issues without human intervention.

Legacy providers only provide reconciliation for month end close applications. End Close continuously reconciles with developer friendly APIs, allowing teams to integrate real time payments data within their products to create product experiences for customers like faster balance top-ups, instant trading etc. 

New payment rails and agent-to-agent payments are increasing online transaction volumes, making reconciliation a growing challenge for companies. David (CTO and 2nd time YC founder) most recently built these kinds of high-scale ingestion pipelines when starting and leading error tracking at PostHog (W20), the fastest growing product in the company's history.
one_liner: AI powered reconciliation for high-volume payments companies

launches.title: End Close: Solving payments reconciliation with AI Agents
launches.tagline: AI powered reconciliation at scale
launches.body:
**TLDR**

End Close is building automatic reconciliation for payments companies, replacing manual ops work with AI agents that automatically investigate and resolve every exception.

Our team has 6 years of experience building systems to reconcile a trillion dollars annually.

<https://youtu.be/5xral3GHBVs>

**The Problem**

Every day, ops teams at payments companies spend hours manually investigating exceptions - transactions that didn't match, funds that can't be accounted for, discrepancies across banks, processors, and ledgers. Legacy reconciliation tools weren't built for this. They were designed for month-end close, not real-time fintech infrastructure. And the cost of getting it wrong is real: lost money, unreliable financials, and compliance exposure.

**The Solution**

End Close continuously ingests records from your banks, processors, and data warehouse - so exceptions are caught as soon as they arise, not weeks later during month-end close.

And unlike most reconciliation tools that only tell you something is wrong, our AI agent handles exceptions end-to-end before they have time to compound - pulling context from connected systems, finding the root cause, and resolving them without looping in your team. Hours of manual investigation become minutes of autonomous work, with full transparency into every decision.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98256&key=user_uploads/348419/736cf82d-73f6-460b-9223-a963e79187e9)

Sean spent 6 years building the reconciliation org at Modern Treasury (S18) where he was the 2nd engineering hire, processing a trillion dollars in payments across 40 banks with 99.995% automation. He has built high volume ACH and Wire origination systems and is the primary contributor of the popular open-sourced LedgerSync library for integrating with legacy ERP providers.

David is a second time founder, having previously gone through YC S19 with Unflow, helped creators earn $100k+ selling live classes online during COVID. Since then he led the error tracking team at PostHog (W20). He was responsible for launching and growing the product to thousands of customers in its first 6 months, the fastest growing in the company’s history. Hey YC - We’re [Aryah Oztanir](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aryah-oztanir/) and [Ajay Misra](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ajay-misra/), the co-founders of [o11.ai](http://o11.ai).

\
TL;DR - AI in legacy tools (e.g. Copilot, Gemini in Workspace, etc…) sucks. We built o11 to make automation directly inside legacy tools easy.

# See us in action (demo vid):

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0nlcwZ6bw_c>

# The Problem:

62% of all companies still rely on legacy software and systems. Many of these systems are manual, outdated, and inefficient. In the age of AI, the legacy giants that create this software aim to “duct tape” AI onto their tools – but what they end up with is a **mangled mess that can’t actually do anything useful (Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, the generic useless “AI” sidebar in every application).** Enterprises and consumers need a way to automate work directly inside of the tools they are familiar with – \*\*their solution is o11.\*\*\
\
Starting with **the entire Google & Microsoft Suite,** we’ve enabled hundreds of companies to automate presentation / spreadsheet / document generation directly within their workflow. Teams that use us no longer need to move from app to app or deal with agents that merely “provide insights.” Now they can actually do things in these tools, and do them **fast.**

# Start today:

Try o11 for Free in Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 at <https://o11.ai>. Book a demo at <https://o11.ai/book-demo>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98341&key=user_uploads/1788479/2a4f8871-f9de-4f49-9758-39a582173ea4)

# 

# How did we come up with this?

Before we dropped out of UNC we were surrounded by finance students who all faced similar problems at their internships over the summer: Legacy software, no AI, and tons of grunt work. Most existing finance solutions thought the best way to provide workflow value was to build an external dashboard. But after speaking to hundreds of finance professionals we realized that teams don’t want an external solution, they require something that is directly within their workflow. So, we started by building a Microsoft PowerPoint plugin. Soon, financial teams started asking us for more, and we then introduced o11 For Excel and o11 For Word. But, why confine ourselves to Microsoft only? Teams that we worked with and spoke to all wanted integrations with the full G Workspace suite, and soon we built it for them in Google Slides, Docs, and Sheets. **We’re not stopping there though – while these productivity suites are a large part of our user’s workflows, their workflows aren’t just confined to these tools.**

# Where does this go?

Our users use thousands of enterprise legacy apps that need automation, not duct-taped AI. That’s why, the product we’re soon going to release will enable you to use o11 in any app — **it’s going to enable you** **to automate directly inside any workflow.**

The finance & accounting industry is broken - so **we’re building Balance to fix it.**

Companies spend over $680B each year on accounting services. Yet +80% of firms still rely on manual, spreadsheet-based reconciliation processes, and small business owners spend 20+ hours every week managing their books, from invoicing and expenses to reporting and taxes.

**As former CFOs and business owners, we’ve lived the problem for years:**

* Paying thousands per month for late, inaccurate books
* Scrambling to fix errors before board meetings
* Waiting weeks for sloppy month-end closes
* Chasing receipts to stay compliant

\
**Why hasn’t this been solved?**

Because bookkeeping isn’t just rules - it’s judgment. And traditional firms aren’t built to solve this with AI. But companies needed this _yesterday;_ Despite only incorporating in January, we are already active across multiple industries helping some of the most forward-looking and modern companies in everything from tech, ecommerce, florists, to digital consultants, close their books **faster**, **cheaper** and more **accurately**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97794&key=user_uploads/2342832/6a4d536d-9b7c-413f-8a3a-c909d22c5a13)

We’re building the accounting firm we always wished existed; combining AI systems with human experts to deliver **clean books, real-time insights, and instant answers.**

**Our AI agents ingest your business context — revenue, payroll, banking, expenses, ledger, and automate the full back-office finance stack.**

Our agents categorize transactions, reconcile accounts, and surface anomalies in real time, with a human in the loop for review and accuracy.

Once the books are clean, Balance becomes the easiest way to actually _understand_ them.

Founders can dive into costs, audit subscriptions, break down revenue, and validate taxes; all from where they work (Slack, WhatsApp, email), without waiting on PDFs or parsing spreadsheets. It’s your outsourced finance function. Accurate books, responsive, and always up-to-date.

launches.title: Arden: AI-native platform for audit teams
launches.tagline: Run your audits in minutes, not weeks
launches.body:
Hey everyone!

We're[ ](https://linkedin.com/in/aryamankhanna)Aryaman and David, co-founders of[ ](https://arden.ai)Arden.

**TL;DR:** Arden is the AI-native platform for audit and SOX teams.

**Ask:** Intros to VPs of Internal Audit / CAEs at public tech companies. [founders@ardentech.ai](mailto:founders@ardentech.ai) or[ ](https://arden.ai)[ardentech.ai](http://ardentech.ai)

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgOVq8En4yg&feature=youtu.be>

### **The Problem**

Internal audit still runs on spreadsheets and screenshots.

Every year, audit teams test hundreds of controls to prove the company's financials are trustworthy. For each one, someone spends weeks chasing colleagues for evidence buried in 20+ disconnected systems and manually testing in Excel. They do the same work every quarter.

SOX compliance costs almost $2M a year at a public company, and 70%+ of that is labor. Teams outsource the overflow to consulting firms at $500-1,000 an hour and burn another seven figures.

The tools that exist today store the workpapers, but don’t do the work.

### **The Solution**

Arden is the AI-native platform that runs audit tests end-to-end.

1. **Plugs into your stack.** Connects to your control library, source systems, and past audit data. Learns how your team audits, and builds that knowledge over time
2. **Gathers evidence from every system.** Computer-use AI agents navigate legacy systems and capture the screenshots external auditors require. Direct integrations pull from your modern stack, saving auditors weeks of back and forth.
3. **Chases down control owners for you.** A Slack/Teams agent follows up with control owners, saving auditors weeks of back and forth. Our agent has the right context already filled in, so control owners just confirm.
4. **Runs control tests.** Arden’s testing engine supports full-population or sample-based testing. It catches every exception and flags them for review.
5. **Produces workpapers ready for external auditors.** Every conclusion ties back to the source evidence, with full traceability into how Arden reached it. 

Audit work hasn't changed in 30 years even as the systems in scope have doubled. We’re rebuilding audit from the ground up.

### **The Team**

Aryaman and David have been best friends since 6th grade. Aryaman studied CS at Berkeley and David studied AI at MIT, and we’ve done research on LLM reliability (and a million other projects) together.

**Our Ask**

If you can intro us to any of the following, we'd love it:

* **VPs of Internal Audit, CAEs, or SOX directors** at public companies
* **CFOs or Controllers** at public or pre-IPO companies
* **Anyone at a Big 4 or mid-tier firm** doing co-sourced SOX work

[founders@ardentech.ai](mailto:founders@ardentech.ai) or book a demo at [ardentech.ai](https://ardentech.ai)

Shielded helps manufacturers understand and act on supply chain risk in real time.

As the world has become more volatile, businesses need a tool to monitor events and rapidly take action. Founder James Simon saw this problem first hand in commodities trading, in fact his whole job was to take advantage of other firms reacting too slowly as the world changed. 

That’s what inspired him to build Shielded, as an intelligence layer that integrates quickly, deeply understands your specific business, and turns volatility into clear, proactive decisions.

Shielded supports critical part and supplier management for leading defense companies, ingredient price audits for multinational CPG firms, and tariff impact analysis for global manufacturers.

With API, MCP, BOM, and spreadsheet integrations, every customer deployment to date has taken less than 72 hours.

Instead of simply receiving an alert when something happens, Shielded gives procurement, finance, and supply chain teams company-specific guidance on the impacts of external events, market shifts, and regulation changes, and recommends the right operational or hedging responses.

Shielded is your supply chain’s command center that never sleeps.
